scripts.db:init: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm backend node scripts/db/init.js
scripts.db:seed: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm backend node scripts/db/seed.js
scripts.db:clear: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm backend node scripts/db/clear.js
scripts.db:reset: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm backend sh -c 'node scripts/db/clear.js && node scripts/db/seed.js'
